section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section contains the heading and date of the maamar for Shabbos Parshas Eikev, 20 Menachem Av 5716.
This section notes that the maamar is an unedited draft.
This section explains that the phrase "you will surely listen" in the verse refers to the time of the heels of Moshiach, the final generation, when there is no more time to delay refining the sparks.
section.t: "And it will be, because you will listen to these ordinances and keep and do them, then Hashem your G-d will keep for you the covenant and the kindness that He swore [to your forefathers]."
And the precise point in this is known,
that the expression "tishme'un" (you will listen) means you will surely listen,
and this is because "eikev" refers to the time of the heels of Moshiach (Ikvasa d'Moshicha),
and since it is the very last generation,
because it is the very last generation and it is impossible to wait any longer,
there is no time left to postpone the refinements (birurim),
and therefore you will surely listen.
